title: Improving Supercomputer Usage with Aging Awareness
problem: Electronic device lifetime directly impacts environmental footprint. GPU shortage increases need to extend device lifetime. Device aging is strongly temperature-dependent. Need optimization of machine usage before failure while maintaining performance.
motivation: High demand for GPUs reduces availability; extending hardware lifetime reduces environmental impact and cost. Frequency scaling trades performance for temperature reduction and extended device lifespan. Need intelligent scheduling strategies.
method: Investigate node frequency reconfiguration to optimize HPC usage before failure. Compare dedicated scheduling algorithm (aging-aware) with constant-frequency baseline. Evaluate robustness to aging model inaccuracy.
key_novelty: Aging-aware scheduling for HPC; temperature-frequency-lifetime trade-off optimization; analysis of algorithm robustness to model uncertainty.
contributions: Aging-aware scheduling algorithm for HPC systems
Analysis of frequency scaling trade-offs for device lifetime
Robustness study to aging model inaccuracy
limitations: Abstract only; specific aging models not detailed; no performance numbers provided; unclear applicability beyond GPUs; robustness evaluation methodology not described.
